charts.subtitle: Bars show the area of each site inside this basin.

method: Ramsar Sites of International Importance (Ramsar Sites Information Service, 2,551 sites) as H3 res-8 cells, joined to the basin's res-6 cells. A site's area in the basin is the area of its distinct res-8 cells there (points-only sites are a single small cell); a site that spans basins counts in each. The Ramsar share is the share of the basin's area in any site; the wetland share is the share of its GLWD wetland area (classes 8–32) in any site. The Montreux Record lists sites where a change in ecological character has occurred, is occurring or is likely. Ramsar sites are shown for comparison only: they do not enter any pillar score, and the leaderboard ranks every basin unless 'Basins with Ramsar sites' is chosen.
